page.title: Violence District Roblox Quiz: 15 Questions on Killers and Items
page.description_md: Think you know how a Violence District round plays out? Easy questions cover the roles, the team's goal and the basic tools. Hard ones get into specific Killer abilities and how they change a chase.
page.seo_description: Test your Roblox Violence District knowledge with 15 questions on roles, pallets, Survivor items and Killer abilities, from easy basics to hard chase details.

easy.question: How many Killers and Survivors are in a standard round?

options.text: One Killer against five Survivors
One Killer against four Survivors
Two Killers against five Survivors
Two Killers against four Survivors

easy.question: What is the Killer's main job in a round?

options.text: Repair generators before the Survivors finish them.
Hunt Survivors down and stop them from escaping.
Escort Survivors safely to the exit gates.
Guard the pallets so Survivors can't use them.

easy.question: What do pallets let Survivors do?

options.text: Heal teammates and restore their items.
Reveal the Killer and power the exit gates.
Stun the Killer and help break a chase.
Hide Survivors and repair generators faster.

easy.question: How can a Survivor get out of a round alive?

options.text: Only after every Survivor escapes at once.
Only together with at least one teammate.
Only after the Killer leaves through the exit.
Either together with teammates or alone.

easy.question: How many generators must the Survivor team repair to finish its objective?

options.text: Four generators, shared by the whole team.
Five generators, shared by the whole team.
Five generators, and each Survivor repairs all five.
Six generators, shared by the whole team.

easy.question: How do Survivors win a round?

options.text: They finish the objectives, then reach an exit.
After all Survivors fall, the Killer reaches an exit.
Before the objectives, they find the Killer.
Before the objectives, they repair the exit.

easy.question: Where do Survivor items come from?

options.text: They are map drops that the Killer can also pick up.
They only come from badges earned after a round.
Every role gets them free at the start of a round.
They're bought in the shop and equipped in the loadout.

medium.question: What does a Flashlight do to the Killer?

options.text: It knocks the Killer back and breaks a nearby pallet.
It blinds the Killer and makes them drop a carried Survivor.
It heals its user and hides them during a chase.
It marks a nearby generator for every Survivor.

medium.question: When you use a Bandage, how many health states do you recover?

options.text: One health state
Four health states
Three health states
Two health states

medium.question: What happens when the Parrying Dagger parries the Killer's attack?

options.text: It stuns the Killer for a few seconds.
It breaks the nearest pallet for the Survivor.
It applies Anti-Heal to the Killer.
It reveals every exit gate to the team.

medium.question: What does Adrenaline Shot do when you use it in the dying state?

options.text: It fully heals you and clears the dying state.
It keeps you standing for the rest of the round.
It briefly picks you back up, then you fall again.
It leaves you downed for the rest of the round.

medium.question: How does the Motion Tracker's sound change as the Killer gets closer?

options.text: It beeps faster and at a higher pitch.
It beeps slower and at a lower pitch.
It stays silent until the Killer starts a chase.
It beeps only when a generator finishes.

medium.question: What does the WaxBound Candle do?

options.text: It reveals every pallet and window in range.
It hides a Survivor's aura while they are spiked.
It reveals the Killer's aura for a short time.
It lights an exit gate for every Survivor.

medium.question: What happens to The Hidden when he stays still?

options.text: He hides his aura after hitting a generator.
He becomes invincible while sprinting.
He reveals Survivors when he crouches.
He becomes completely invisible.

medium.question: What triggers Great Collapse's speed boost?

options.text: Vaulting a window at full speed.
Stunning the Killer with a pallet.
Healing a downed teammate nearby.
Repairing a generator to completion.

medium.question: Which actions does The Slasher's Lake of Mist disable while active?

options.text: Moving, vaulting and destroying objects.
Moving, vaulting and attacking.
Attacking, vaulting and destroying objects.
Moving, attacking and destroying objects.

hard.question: What makes The Stalker's Evil's Grasp gauge fill faster?

options.text: Standing still after a Survivor is downed.
Landing basic hits from long range.
Repairing generators near the exit gate.
Stalking a visible Survivor from closer range.

hard.question: What does a successful Evil's Grasp hit apply to the Survivor it catches?

options.text: Anti-Heal on the Survivor
A speed boost on the Survivor
Full healing for the Survivor
A reveal of every exit gate

hard.question: What does the Through the Veil ability let The Veil's spears do?

options.text: Stop at the first wall they hit.
Heal The Veil after each throw.
Pass through walls without colliding.
Reveal the Survivor they hit to the team.

hard.question: While holding her spears, what must The Veil do before carrying a Survivor?

options.text: Throw both of her spears first.
Switch back to her dagger.
Land a Through the Veil throw first.
Wait for the spear charge to refill.

hard.question: What does The Cure's Elucidation apply to Survivors it hits?

options.text: Full healing
A speed boost
Anti-Heal
Pestilence

hard.question: What can The Cure do with a charge earned by spiking Survivors?

options.text: Turn a generator into a Pestilence cloud.
Turn a corpse into an SCP-049-2.
Revive the nearest Survivor at an exit.
Turn a pallet into a healing item.

hard.question: What does Mask Up do for The Masked?

options.text: It switches to a randomly chosen mask.
It copies a Survivor's loadout for the round.
It locks one mask in for the whole round.
It swaps masks only once the exit gates power.

hard.question: During The Slasher's Pursuit, what happens to a dropped pallet he touches?

options.text: It powers up an exit gate for the Survivors.
It is repaired and stood back up for everyone.
It is destroyed instantly and can't be used again.
It restores health to the Survivors nearby.

hard.question: What happens on the fourth chained hit of The Killer's Frenzy?

options.text: The target is downed, even if healthy.
The target is injured but stays standing.
Only an already-injured target is downed.
The target is eliminated from the match.
